title: Historical Backtest Snapshot
description: Results for one (ticker, cutoff_date) backtesting window.

cutoff_date.description: Date gate: only FMP financial records strictly on or before this date are used. No forward data leakage.

price_at_cutoff.description: Closing price closest to cutoff_date from yfinance (auto_adjust=True).

pe_ratio.description: Most recent P/E from FMP ratios, as of cutoff_date.

ev_ebitda.description: Most recent EV/EBITDA from FMP ratios or key-metrics.

mean_pe_history.description: Mean P/E across all available FMP records before cutoff.

mean_ev_history.description: Mean EV/EBITDA across all available FMP records before cutoff.

net_profit_margin.description: Net profit margin % from most recent FMP record.

gross_profit_margin.description: Gross profit margin % from most recent FMP record.

signal.description: BUY if P/E or EV/EBITDA ≥15% below historical mean. SELL if ≥30% above. HOLD otherwise. This is signal family 1 (valuation-multiple). Distinct from FinRobot recommendation (family 2) and critic-revised (family 3).

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of the signal, e.g. 'P/E 39.9x is 39% below historical mean 65.9x'.

ratio_history_depth.description: Number of historical P/E records available.

fmp_records.description: Count of FMP records available before cutoff_date.

return_3m.description: Total return at +3 months (%), null if not yet available.

alpha_3m.description: Return minus SPY return over same period.

spy_returns.description: SPY benchmark returns over same horizons.
